title: Share Capital—Reacquired Own Equity Instruments (Treasury Shares)
summary: Addressed accounting for reacquired own equity instruments (treasury shares), confirming they should be deducted from equity with no gain or loss recognised. Withdrawn in 2003.

related.title: Financial Instruments: Presentation
related.relationship: The parent standard whose 2003 revision superseded SIC-16 by incorporating treasury share treatment directly into IAS 32.33–34
